notes.title: 1.02.04 - Optimization
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

This minor update improves the overall optimization of the game and should reduce lags.
If you encounter any problems or bugs, please report them.

Enjoy the game!

notes.title: Vox Populi: Australia 2025
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

The new game in the series: “[b]Vox Populi: Australia 2025[/b]”, about the Australian elections, is finally available on Steam!
It features all the new elements of Vox Populi with something unique: [u]post-apocalypse scenarios[/u].

These scenarios include a new map, new events, new traits, new laws and new mechanisms.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3539270/Vox_Populi_Australia_2025

notes.title: 2025 presidential election
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

The major new "[b]Presidential Election[/b]" update for [b]Vox Populi: Polska[/b] is now available!

As the name suggests, this update adds a new scenario based on this year's presidential election. This scenario adds new characters and a new election system: no longer parliamentary, but direct election with two rounds.

A few minor corrections have also been made to the game.
Enjoy the game!

[h1]More news from the franchise[/h1]

The [u]sci-fi scenarios[/u] in "[b]Vox Populi: USA 2024[/b]" have been improved, and "[b]Vox Populi: Australia 2025[/b]" will soon be released with new [u]post-apocalyptic[/u] scenarios.

If you're interested in this kind of atypical scenario, don't hesitate to take a look!

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3061790/Vox_Populi_USA_2024][img]https://i.ibb.co/jPkPGpJr/Image-Polska-Update.png[/img][/url]

notes.title: Scenarios and Debates
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

The new major update for [b]Vox Populi: Poland 2023[/b] is finally available!

[b][u]Warning[/u][/b]: The first time you start the game, you may see an error message asking you to click a button. Once you've clicked the button, the problem should be solved once and for all.

[b]Here are the main additions to the game:[/b]

[list][*][b]Four new alternate scenarios[/b] that add fictional situations, randomness, and varying levels of difficulty. These scenarios are classic, and more unique scenarios will be added in future.
[*][b]A new debate and card system[/b], including the ability to speed up debates, and a new resource: [u]rhetoric points[/u], with which you can buy new cards for your deck.
[*][b]A better balance of difficulty[/b]: the main scenario will be less difficult to win, and the final situation between opposing characters will be more realistic.
[*][b]A redesigned interface[/b], including the ability to close almost all panels with the "Escape" button or by clicking outside, keyboard shortcuts to open them, and a windowed mode for the game.
[*]Streamer mode and a victory music
[*]Five new Steam Achievements
[*]Several minor additions and fixes[/list]

[b][u]What's next?[/u][/b]

[u]Unique[/u] new scenarios for Poland will be added in future major updates. The first of these will be the presidential election of 2025, with a [b]non-parliamentary electoral system[/b] and [b]new characters[/b] and starting data close to the real situation in the country.

[b]Please report any problems or bugs! Enjoy the game![/b]

notes.title: USA and Science fiction
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

Before the future major updates to Vox Populi: Poland 2023, the new game in the franchise, '[b]Vox Populi: USA 2024[/b]' is now available! Take on the role of one of the candidates in this year's US presidential election, or start one of the [b]seven other fictional scenarios[/b] available!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3061790/Vox_Populi_USA_2024

Here's a non-exhaustive list of what's new from this version:

[list][*][b]Unique events[/b] linked to real events in the country
[*]A new voting system: the [b]Electoral College[/b], with new [i]Winner-take-all[/i] strategies
[*]A [b]referendum system[/b] that allows candidates to pass laws that give them an advantage or a total victory
[*]A new deck building system and a new resource: [b]Rhetoric Points[/b]
[*][b][u]But most importantly[/u][/b]: [b]Science fiction scenarios[/b] with their own ideologies, corpuses, character traits, events and regions. You can play as an alien, an advocate of equality between species, or the opposite, of the domination of one species over another.[/list]
If you wish, our [u]new Discord server[/u] has just been updated so we can communicate: https://discord.com/invite/N8E5Yc72Ym


[b]See you soon![/b]

notes.title: Europa and Polska
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! An announcement to talk about the new game in the [b]Vox Populi[/b] franchise and upcoming updates for [b]Vox Populi: Polska[/b].

[h1][u]Vox Populi: Europa 2024[/u][/h1]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2842880/Vox_Populi_Europa_2024

[b]Vox Populi: Europa 2024[/b] was released yesterday on Steam. The game focuses on the European Union and contains many new features:

[list][*] Seven scenarios, including the 2024 European Union elections and many other futuristic fictional scenarios
[*] A new mechanism of laws and referendums to be organised during the campaign
[*] Unique combinations of ideologies and Corpus, linked to dozens of new European and national flags.
[*] A new system of political paths specific to Europe, allowing players to navigate between Europeanism, Socialism and Sovereignism[/list]
With the [b]Vox Populi - Collection[/b] Bundle, you can also get all the games in the franchise for cheaper :

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/42066/Vox_Populi__Collection


[h1][u]The future of Vox Populi: Polska[/u][/h1]

There are several major free updates planned for [b]Vox Populi: Polska 2023[/b] in the coming months, including the addition of futuristic scenarios, improvements to the debate system, and some unique mechanics.

[b]See you soon for more news![/b]

notes.title: V1.00.04
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

A few new features in this update:

[list][*]Better balance. [b]Candidates will be attacked less[/b].
[*]A new ideological corpus: "[b]Socialist International[/b]".
[*]A few bug fixes[/list]

A major free update should be released before the summer, [b]with new scenarios for greater replayability[/b].
Please report any bugs or problems.

Enjoy the game!

notes.title: V1.00.03
notes.notes:
Witajcie wszystkie osoby!

Ta wersja wprowadza kilka zmian. Nie jest kompatybilna z wcześniejszymi zapisami gry. Jeśli chcesz kontynuować zapisy, musisz wrócić do poprzednich wersji.

[list][*] Teraz możesz podejmować akcje i przypisywać działania podczas wydarzeń, z kilkoma wyjątkami.
[*] Gra jest teraz lepiej zrównoważona, a osiągnięcie ponad 50% głosów jest trochę łatwiejsze.
[*] Liczba kandydatów została zmniejszona z 14 do 8.
[*] Osiągnięcia zdobywa się za wszystkie możliwe zwycięstwa. Nowe osiągnięcie (Zwycięstwo przytłaczające) zdobywa się tylko przy najlepszym możliwym zwycięstwie.
[*] Kilka poprawek tekstów i naprawa błędów.[/list]
Prosimy o zgłaszanie wszelkich błędów czy też problemów. Dziękujemy!

----------------------------------------

Hello everyone!

This version introduces a few changes. It is not compatible with old saves. You'll have to go back to the old versions if you want to continue with them.

[list][*] It is now possible to take actions and perform activities during events, with some exceptions.
[*] The game is better balanced and achieving more than 50% of votes is a little easier.
[*] The number of candidates has been reduced from 14 to 8.
[*] Achievements are won with all possible victories. A new success (Landslide victory) can only be won with the best possible victory.
[*] A few text and bug corrections.[/list]
Please report any bugs or errors.

notes.title: v1.00.02.c - Poprawki w tekście i tłumaczeniach
notes.notes:
Ta wersja naprawia błędy w tekście i tłumaczeniach, które zostały wprowadzone wersją 1.00.02. Niektóre z tych problemów zostaną naprawione dopiero podczas nowych gier.

Przepraszamy i dziękujemy za zgłaszanie innych problemów, na jakie możecie państwo natknąć się podczas gry.

--------------------------------------

This version fixes text and translation errors that were introduced with version 1.00.02. Some of these issues will only be fixed during new games.

Sorry and thank you for reporting any other problems you may encounter during the game.

notes.title: v1.00.02
notes.notes:
Wersja ta nie jest kompatybilna z wcześniejszymi zapisami gry. Jeśli chcesz kontynuować grę, wróć do wersji 1.00.00.

[b]Lista zmian:[/b]

[list]
[*] Nowy samouczek. Jeśli brakuje informacji, proszę sugerować dodatki.
[*] Wielkie debaty są teraz ograniczone do 4 postaci.
[*] Poprawki błędów i tekstów. Jeśli pozostały jakieś problemy, proszę je zgłaszać na forum.
[/list]

-----------------------------------

Version 1.00.02. This version is not compatible with old saves. If you wish to continue a game, return to version 1.00.00.

[b]List of changes :[/b]

[list]
[*]A new tutorial. If any information is missing, please suggest additions.
[*]Great debates are now limited to 4 characters.
[*] Bug and text corrections. If any remain, please report them on the forum.
[/list]
